hero.lead: A platform for online auctions of antiques and collectibles. Buy and sell unique lots in a convenient mobile app.

about.title: About the platform
about.p1: Antiques Auction connects collectors, sellers, and buyers in one place. Users can auction lots, place real-time bids, track delivery status, and manage their profiles.
about.p2: Moderators and administrators work via a web panel: verifying lots, managing users, and analyzing platform statistics.

download.title: Mobile App
download.desc: Download the official antiques-mobile app to participate in auctions, favorite lots, and receive bid notifications.
